sourceFormat.channels: mono (spatialised SFX), stereo (ambience, medals, UI stings)

gun-ar.notes: M4A1-class. AR-15 D_32P + Marlin 336 I_22P near takes as bodies (4 real takes, L/R mics), Ruger Single Six transient as the snap, .22 mid-distance take as the tail. Tight 340 ms decay.

gun-ak.notes: AK47-class. Four separate AK-47 C_28P near singles (real round-robin), 1911 crack layered for snap, AK mid-distance C_31P for the tail. Fattest low-mid of the four classes.

gun-smg.notes: SMG. Carl Gustav M45 x3 + PPSh near singles, Walther PPQ 9 mm snap. Shortest of the set (~200 ms) so full-auto never smears.

gun-sniper.notes: M40A3-class. Four Mosin Nagant M_21P near singles pitched down, Model 12 shotgun lowpassed to 900 Hz as the chest sub, long AK mid-distance tail. 880 ms max.

gun-ar-far.notes: Other-player / distant AR. Real AK-47 mid-distance take, gentle 4.2 kHz rolloff, 3.5 ms soft attack, 42% wet dark reverb, two offset reflections. Rendered ~7.5 dB below the near shots so 20 of them stack politely.

gun-ak-far.notes: Distant AK. Same mid-distance source, slower and darker (3.8 kHz), longest far tail.

gun-smg-far.notes: Distant SMG from the .22 mid-distance take — smallest, driest, quickest of the far set.

gun-sniper-far.notes: Distant sniper from the 1911 mid-distance take pitched down 0.86x — a boom with almost no crack, the 'someone is shooting across the map' cue.

reload-out.notes: Stage 1/3, shared across classes. metalLatch release + handgun-reload mag-drop.

reload-in.notes: Stage 2/3, shared. Mag seat from handgun-reload-zer0sol + a soft impact for weight.

reload-rack.notes: Stage 3/3, shared. assaultriflereload1 charging handle + rubberduck metal clack.

reload-rack-sniper.notes: Bolt-action stage 3 variant for the sniper: shotguncock at 0.82x + metalClick lockup.

step-dirt.notes: Walk on jungle floor. TinyWorlds gravel/mud/leaves with a Kenney grass step lowpassed underneath. Run = same files at 1.12-1.2x rate and a shorter interval.

step-metal.notes: Walk on crates / ship deck. Thimras takes 03/08/14/21 (recorded for games) + concrete step for weight. Run = rate, not new files.

hitmarker.notes: 130 ms, highpassed at 320 Hz so it sits on top of the shot instead of fighting it.

headshot.notes: Hitmarker punch + a bell and pluck a just 5th/octave above the kill-confirm root — same key, higher register.

kill-confirm.notes: The dopamine cue: punch, then major-pentatonic 3rd -> 5th -> octave with a steel-drum octave and a sub-octave bong. Stereo.

damage-taken.notes: Deliberately dark: 5.2 kHz lowpass, -9 dB at 3.3 kHz, cannon sub under it. Never stings when you are already being hurt.

nade-throw.notes: Two artisticdude swishes pitched down 0.72x/0.85x for a heavy arm arc.

nade-bounce.notes: Two surfaces: soft impact + gravel (dirt), wood + tin (crate/metal). Pick by surface or at random.

explosion-near.notes: Firework cannon body + Kenney sub + debris crunch, 1.8 s, 3.2 kHz dipped 9 dB.

explosion-far.notes: Muffled distant explosion + a 0.72x cannon sub, 2.6 kHz lowpass, 40% wet 2 s reverb.

medal-3.notes: Tier 3 (triple): four-note run to the octave.

medal-streak.notes: Banner: full six-note major-pentatonic run with a steel-drum 12th on top. All medals share one root, so overlapping tiers stay consonant.

ui-click.notes: Tiny, 140 ms, octave pluck under the click.

ui-deploy.notes: Root -> 5th with a sub-octave bong. Same root as the medals.

match-start.notes: Rising steel-drum root-5th-octave over a bong pedal.

match-end.notes: MASHED! — descending pentatonic octave-6th-5th-3rd resolving onto a held root.

amb-jungle.notes: 48 s seamless stereo bed: BigSoundBank forest ambience + two detuned cicada layers panned wide + a dawn-chorus layer, 4 s equal-power wrap crossfade, no edge fades. Loop it forever.

amb-bird.notes: Sparse one-shots over the bed — screaming piha (the jungle bird) and a chirp cluster. Fire every 8-25 s at random pan.

amb-insect.notes: Cicada swell with 350 ms in / 450 ms out fades so it blooms rather than triggers.
